description:
A profile field `identity.managed_fields` may give to K2. A listed field changes only
through mgmt (`/mgmt/v1/principals/*`); a client write naming it answers `403
policy_denied` with `details.reason = "managed_by_provider"`. `username` and `email`
are always K2's in K2 mode and are not listed.

oneOf.description:
The avatar: `POST /api/v1/me/avatar` and `/me/avatar/clear` are refused, and
`POST /mgmt/v1/principals/avatar` is the only writer (`force` replaces an avatar the
member set before).

title: ManagedProfileField
